# Addresses permitted in commit authorship, commit messages and tracked file content; the guard
# rejects everything else. An entry here is the record of the decision to publish that address, so
# add it in the same commit as the address it permits.
#
# One entry per line: a full address, or *@domain for a whole domain.

# Maintainer, via GitHub's noreply form.
*@users.noreply.github.com

# GitHub automation, including the Signed-off-by trailer Dependabot writes.
actions@github.com
noreply@github.com
support@github.com

# RFC 2606 example domains; they route nowhere.
*@example.com
